material_class: one opaque atlas PBR; all embedded, no external resources
shared_motion_uri: characters/pip-shared-motion/pip-shared-motion.glb (existing package; resolve with game asset base at later integration)
transform_recipe: worldPosition = bone.matrixWorld * skeleton.boneInverses[boneIndex] * restPositionGltf. Bone.matrixWorld already contains instance/world transforms; do not multiply the instance transform a second time. These rest anchors use the source skin bind coordinates (mesh bindMatrix is identity in this GLB). Directions use the upper3x3 of the same deformation matrix and normalize; effects/bridge keep world +Y up.
interrupt: Stop optional FX immediately; stop emissions, clear pooled particles/projectiles owned by the interrupted cast as game policy requires; fade back using shared-motion fade times. Equipment remains visible and bound.
root_motion: No new root movement; controller owns world jump translation, gravity, double impulse and landing. Air/Glide renders use a documented .18 source-unit presentation lift on the instance, never baked into clips.
legacy_tool_action: Attack_Mining_UseItem is preserved for compatibility; it now is an empty equipment gesture and should not be selected as this form ability.
equipment: Open, rounded CC0 balance hands; no extra cuffs/tethers without a real harness connection. Shoulder harness and cape are original.
release_semantics: Jump_Start takeoff; no projectile/cast release. Glide is entered by controller while airborne.
visibility: Cape always visible; 0 folded on ground, 1 in glide, ease between. Hands always visible.
interrupt_override: Exit Glide: retract morph over .20 s and fade clip .18 s; on forced state reset set morph 0. No wrist ropes.

cape.orientation: inherits chest; cloth remains skinned, not spawned world-up
